{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''Gado Hill Clans''', or '''Separatists''' as they were sometimes known, of [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] were an opposition faction to the reigning [[Tundei]] regime during [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] bid for galactic conquest in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. The regime cut all basic supplies, including food, to the hill clans, leaving them forced to rely on [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], like [[Fynn Torve]] of [[Talon Karrde]]'s smuggling organization, to survive.
